name: Carl Miller
biography: Carl Miller is a technologist, journalist and writer. He is the founder of the Centre for the Analysis of Social Media at Demos and the information integrity lab CASM Technology, a Visiting Fellow at the Department of War Studies, King’s College London, a Senior Fellow at the Institute for Strategic Dialogue and a Senior Research Fellow at RAND Europe. He is the author of the The Death of the Gods: The New Global Power Grab which won the Transmission Prize, and is the co-writer and host of the podcast Kill List, which reached #1 in seven countries. It was named the Guardian’s best podcast of 2024, named Podcast of the Year 2025 by the Broadcast Press Guild Awards and was nominated for an Aria and Ambie
